prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: polished portfolio screenshot of an agricultural management web app dashboard
Primary request: Redesign the provided AgroNutri Precision dashboard to look more modern, professional and premium while preserving its identity and business meaning.
Input image: edit target and source of truth for content, page purpose and information architecture.
Style/medium: high-fidelity desktop SaaS interface, crisp production UI screenshot, restrained agricultural technology aesthetic.
Composition/framing: full 16:9 desktop application viewport. Keep a dark forest-green left sidebar with AgroNutri Precision branding and Dashboard, Nutrição, Gado, Sanidade navigation. Improve the main area with a compact page header, stronger KPI hierarchy, 6 well-spaced KPI cards, a prominent weight evolution chart with a smooth green line and readable axes, and a smaller financial summary panel. Reduce excessive empty space.
Color palette: forest green, emerald, sage, warm off-white, white, charcoal. Subtle shadows and thin borders.
Text: Portuguese. Preserve key labels: "AgroNutri Precision", "Dashboard", "Visão geral da operação", "Total de Animais", "Alertas de Estoque", "Bloqueios Sanitários", "GMD Global", "Conversão Alimentar", "Custo por Arroba", "Receita Projetada", "Custo Operacional", "Lucro Projetado", "Evolução de Peso".
Constraints: Keep the same product identity, same agricultural cattle context, and realistic management metrics. Use coherent vector icons. The result must feel like a real production web app screenshot, not a marketing poster.
Avoid: photos, 3D illustration, gradients, glassmorphism, neon colors, mockup device frames, watermark, lorem ipsum, distorted typography.
